description.value: At 14th level, a cleric can apply the Silent Spell and Still Spell feats to a spell he is about to cast. This does not alter the MP cost. He can use this ability once per day at 14th level and one additional time per day for every two cleric levels beyond 14th. Even though this ability does not modify the spell's MP cost, he cannot use this ability to cast a spell whose modified spell level would be above the level of the highest-level spell that he is capable of casting. A 14th-level cleric could use this on a 3rd-level spell (effective 5th-level). This ability always applies both feats (the cleric cannot use it to just apply one or the other).
